title: Disclosure reports a collapsed state while the panel is open
description: The filter button controls a panel and changes its own text, but aria-expanded is never updated, so it keeps reporting false while the panel is visible.
expectedBehaviour: A control that expands and collapses content keeps its expanded state in sync with the content it controls.
actualBehaviour: aria-expanded remains false after the panel opens.
userImpact: Screen-reader users are told the filters are collapsed when they are open, and may not know the new content appeared.

observed.note: Page-level axe run with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and best-practice. No violation was reported for this page in its default state; the control on the same page also passes.

detection.note: The initial state is valid; only the post-interaction state is wrong.

manualTests: Open the panel with a screen reader running and listen to the button's expanded state.

assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Navigate to the target with the VoiceOver rotor and confirm what is announced.

assertions: After the panel opens, aria-expanded is still false on #toggle-a.
tests: tests/subtle-defects.spec.js: keeps the expanded state stale in variant A

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
